Trace, implement and test: Frequency Of Characters

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package Problems_On_String;

public class FrequencyOfCharacters {
    public static void Printfrequency(String str) {
        int[] freq = new int[26];
        for (int i = 0; i < str.length(); i++) {
            freq[str.charAt(i) - 'a']++;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
            if (freq[i] != 0) {
                System.out.print((char) (i + 'a'));
                System.out.print(freq[i] + " ");
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String args[]) {
        String str = "takeuforward";
        Printfrequency(str);
    }

}
